description: Takes what description names out of one of the user's photos, paid from their credits, and fills where it was from what is around it; nothing else in the photo changes. Describe it as the user did, in any language (the people behind me, the bin on the left, the sign and the cables): Luala finds every match and removes the ones the words mean. 4 credits for one or two kinds of thing, 5 for three or four; when nothing matches, nothing is charged and the answer says so. Not on a cutout. Pass the price the user agreed to as max_credits: the photo's prices from get_shoot or list_photos name it. If a call to this tool got no answer, it may already have started: check list_photos before calling it again.
name: remove_objects
title: Remove things from a photo
